title: Half of what you are holding
subject: Mathematics
objective: Find half of a small even number by sharing it into two equal groups.

steps.heading: Sharing with one person
steps.text: You have six sweets and your sister is looking at you. We both know how this ends.
Six sweets. Count them with me.
To be fair, you two must end up with the same number. Not one more for you.
Three for you, three for your sister.
Same size. Nobody is going to cry.

steps.title: rough work
steps.text: On the pad: six shared into two is three.
That three is half of six.

ask.prompt: So what is half of eight?
ask.hint: Share eight into two equal piles and count one pile.

steps.text: That is it. You can share anything now.
